items.title: Lynne Roberts mentioned tonight that Ndjakalenga Mwenentanda and Shyanne Sellers, both on developmental contracts, will be splitting the remaining games, with the pair never being active for the same game. Tonight is Sellers, which means Sunday will be Mwenentanda.
